name: Fixed package with a stated overage rate that does not apply
why: Wayland Baptist Church - Community Outreach, 2026-07-25. Confirmed correct by
the finance owner: $295 package covering 60 cups, exactly 60 served, so the
$4 additional-serving rate does not apply and the invoice is $295 + tax.
The prompt used to zero RATE_PER_SERVING whenever no overage occurred. Two
problems with that: the stated $4 then looked like a dropped price to the
pre-invoice gate (raising a false HIGH alert on a correct event), and a
serving count later corrected to 70 would bill the 10 extras at $0 -- a
RATE_PER_SERVING is now recorded whenever stated. It is financially inert
here because the backend applies it to max(0, served - included) = 0.
Contact phone redacted; it does not affect classification.
